data.text: Luke, I’ll commit to catching 15 tons and donating the full $15,000 directly to the clinic, provided Kate, Jack, and Emma also commit to 15 each and you keep your catch at zero. My family taught me to protect this lake, but protecting our neighbors matters too. This must remain a one-month exception: I also commit to six tons next month under the recovery plan, then ten tons each once the lake is back to 100. Kate, will you commit to your 15-ton catch and donation, and to the recovery limits?
